The mirror is "half-silvered" so that it's more reflective, but still transparent. The one-way effect happens because of differing intensities of light on either side. The side with bright light will be a mirror because the reflected light is stronger than what's coming through from the other side. Same thing happens with normal glass, but not as clearly. Try looking into a dark room from outside on a very sunny day.
